description: Na₂Ga₂Se₃ crystallizes in the monoclinic C2/m space group. There are three inequivalent Na¹⁺ sites. In the first Na¹⁺ site, Na¹⁺ is bonded to six Se²⁻ atoms to form a mixture of corner and edge-sharing NaSe₆ octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles are 2°. There are a spread of Na-Se bond distances ranging from 3.00-3.03 Å. In the second Na¹⁺ site, Na¹⁺ is bonded to six Se²⁻ atoms to form a mixture of corner and edge-sharing NaSe₆ octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles are 2°. There are two shorter (2.97 Å) and four longer (3.03 Å) Na-Se bond lengths. In the third Na¹⁺ site, Na¹⁺ is bonded to six Se²⁻ atoms to form a mixture of distorted corner and edge-sharing NaSe₆ octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles are 2°. All Na-Se bond lengths are 3.19 Å. Ga²⁺ is bonded in a trigonal non-coplanar geometry to three Se²⁻ atoms. There are two shorter (2.46 Å) and one longer (2.47 Å) Ga-Se bond length. There are two inequivalent Se²⁻ sites. In the first Se²⁻ site, Se²⁻ is bonded to four Na¹⁺ and two equivalent Ga²⁺ atoms to form a mixture of corner and edge-sharing SeNa₄Ga₂ octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 0-79°. In the second Se²⁻ site, Se²⁻ is bonded to four Na¹⁺ and two equivalent Ga²⁺ atoms to form a mixture of corner and edge-sharing SeNa₄Ga₂ octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 0-79°.
